items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Oh, Mr. Palama was the boss. Gus and Palama.

ctx.x: Was it a tough place too? Or any fights? We had a police. Oh, yeah.

I didn't have a fight. But, man, it was a rough job. I'll tell you what. I couldn't take that no longer. No, I wouldn't do. One thing, you played anything you wanted. You played two foxtrots and a waltz, you see. So you played a fast one and a swing and a waltz. All night, that's what you had to play. Two choruses. And your dime was gone. And that's all. Some guys would get tickets, man, along with the longest desk. They liked the good, you know. They want to talk to us. They allowed them to talk, you know. No…
Well you played for Paul Bollier recently, huh? I mean just a few years ago?
